task: Find a popular quinoa salad recipe on Allrecipes with more than 500 reviews and a rating above 4 stars. Create a shopping list of ingredients for this recipe and include the total cooking and preparation time.
answer:
Recipe: Easy Quinoa Salad (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229156/zesty-quinoa-salad/)
Rating: 4.8 stars with 1,544 ratings (meets >4 stars and >500 reviews)

Shopping list of ingredients:
- 2 cups water
- 1 cup quinoa
- ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil
- 2 limes, juiced
- 2 teaspoons ground cumin
- 1 teaspoon salt
- ½ teaspoon red pepper flakes, or more to taste
- 1 ½ cups halved cherry tomatoes
- 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed
- 5 green onions, finely chopped
- ¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro
- salt and ground black pepper to taste

Total cooking and preparation time: Prep Time 15 mins + Cook Time 15 mins = Total Time 30 mins
